english.title: Fail to display legal lettering on public service vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a public service vehicle in respect of which, by virtue of section 17(1) of the Transport Act 1980, a certificate

(A)_[of initial fitness]_
(B)_[under section 130 of the Road Traffic Act 1960]_
(C)_[under section 47 of the Road Traffic Act 1972]_

was required, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD..), when the vehicle was not marked with clearly legible characters, not less than 25 millimetres tall, in a conspicuous position on the nearside of the vehicle, in colours which contrasted with their background, and indicating the name of the owner of the vehicle and the owner's principal place of business
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 45 of the Public Service Vehicles (Conditions of Fitness, Equipment, Use and Certification) Regulations 1981 and section 67 of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
